newtown-flats-east.note: Above the Beatty Close flats block (east half; the west half already carries the beatty-close-flat screen). Flats model: world-streets.js v57/v60 (e -143..-86, n 2341). No label/name on the building.

newtown-park-steps.note: Above the steps DOWN from the Newtown Park / Community Centre footpath to the lower path (world-v63.js, e -66 n 2412; v63 replaced the v60 stairs up at e -58.5).

fallen-angels.note: Beside the DAM After Dark sign on Fallen Angels, 83 Marine Parade (world-fx.js damSign, 52.609697,1.736920), offset ~22 m north so the logo stays clear. Music placement only: not a licence or partnership.

gy-train-station.note: Great Yarmouth railway station, Acle New Road (NaPTAN 9100YARMTH 52.612160,1.720886; Wikipedia 52.6118,1.7207). Station building itself is not modelled yet.

seashore-sign.note: Over the Seashore Holiday Park & Seafront sign on North Drive by the Seashore north entrance (OSM node 562733171, 52.631203,1.739301; sign model world-v63.js e205 n3070). Music placement only: not a partnership.

jellicoe-bridge-under.note: Under the Jellicoe Road bridge (OSM ways 231810834/231810835 bridge=yes) on the service lane beneath (OSM way 231810653). Bridge model world-v63.js; screen hangs under the deck (height_m negative = below the default float height).

scroby-sands-beach.note: North Denes beach opposite the Scroby Sands wind farm (30 turbines modelled from OSM generator:source=wind nodes, world-v63.js).
